question: What Is the Most Popular Smoothie at Tropical Smoothie Cafe?
quick_answer: The Bahama Mama is Tropical Smoothie Cafe's signature and most popular smoothie, a blend of strawberry, pineapple, white chocolate and coconut. The Detox Island Green is the most popular better-for-you option, made with spinach, kale, mango, pineapple, banana and ginger.

body.heading: The Bahama Mama is the signature
body.text: The Bahama Mama is the smoothie Tropical Smoothie Cafe is best known for and its top seller. It blends strawberry, pineapple, white chocolate and coconut into a sweet, tropical, dessert-leaning smoothie. A 24 oz is roughly 410 calories, so it sits on the indulgent side of the menu.

body.heading: The Detox Island Green is the healthy favorite
body.text: On the better-for-you side, the Detox Island Green is the most popular pick. It is made with spinach, kale, mango, pineapple, banana and fresh ginger, and at about 180 calories for a 24 oz it is one of the lightest smoothies on the menu. It is the go-to for customers wanting greens without a heavy, sugary blend.

body.heading: Other popular blends
body.text: Beyond those two, the Acai Berry Boost, the Peanut Butter Banana Crunch (a filling, higher-calorie blend) and the Island Green are among the other well-loved smoothies. Many drinks can be customized with added protein, supplements or lighter options.
